target_segments: Adequate coagulation function, defined as international normalized ratio no greater than 1.5 and activated partial thromboplastin time no greater than 1.5 times the upper limit of normal.

text_span: international normalized ratio no greater than 1.5
sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: international normalized ratio is an independently evaluable coagulation requirement with its own threshold.

text_span: activated partial thromboplastin time no greater than 1.5 times the upper limit of normal
sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: activated partial thromboplastin time is a distinct independently evaluable coagulation requirement with its own threshold.

output.notes: The broad adequate-coagulation statement is fully operationalized by the two stated threshold requirements and has no residual pass/fail meaning.
